I don’t see people whining about the Spurs or the Knicks. I mostly see people hating on one team who deserves it.


Derek Thompson (@DKThomp)

My feed is drenched in whining about how much the modern NBA sucks. Seems even more whiny than normal. 

Do other sports have such a vibrant cottage industry of anti-fan posters who are so determined to hate on the sport?

They’re frying SGA in China the movement is worldwide

Video

If the Thunder make the finals and Shai is flopping around and pursing his lips in the post game in the dumbest fit possible while Dort body slams Brunson through the floor, I think we might reach a level of hate for a basketball player not seen since… maybe ever?

Nah I think he just flops all the time while his teammates maul everyone and act like dorks. Let’s not make this too deep.


Lucas Kaplan (@LucasKaplan_)

SGA is terrible for the game to the extent that sports media's transformation into exclusively rage + engagement bait is terrible for the game

SGA *obviously* grifts (at the same rate as other high-usage scorers), and is grifting more in the playoffs. No argument. But I've been radicalized into total Shai fandom because no other player provid

🙄 there’s never anything controversial he ever says. It’s just ‘I’m using my platform to use my platform and we have to think about our platforms to make the world better for platforms’


Bobby Manning (@RealBobManning)

Jaylen on making All-NBA 2nd Team: “I’m not surprised. I’m aware of certain things…who I am, how I use my platform. I’m not the most liked player in the media, at times. At times I’m not the most liked by the fans … some of the things I say and do are a little controversial…”
He wanted that one lol. What a psycho
This game is like 10 peak westbrooks running at each other full speed
Whatever the spurs are doing to identify dogs is remarkable. Harper and Castle are one thing but Devin Vassell looks like one of the best playoff players in the league right now. Zero fear.

A few tweaks I put in  
1) avoid similes 
2) avoid vagaries especially sentences that end in a word like ‘somewhere’ or ‘nothing’ 
3) no fidget details like ‘ran a finger along the table’

One thing over all the rounds, people are worse at spotting fakes than reals. Also obviously with a few tweaks, it’s really hard to tell the difference. I’m gonna maybe try to increase the sample length to 400 words from 200 and see if it becomes easier to spot.
12000 rounds and we are up from 52% to 53%. Go humans.
You shouldn’t celebrate coming in 16th. Just apologize to the fans and walk off the field and then get transferred to Lyon or something.

They gotta improve this trophy looks like a sign at some digital security conference or something
